messages.subject: Project Marlin - Subscription Agreement v1 and Articles
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Attached our first draft Subscription Agreement and Amended Articles for Project Marlin, plus the disclosure letter shell to follow. Warranty package is business + tax from the Company and Founders, Founders capped at proceeds, Company cap at £2m, 24-month survival on business warranties. Look forward to your mark-up.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Marlin - Subscription Agreement v1 and Articles
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Mark-up attached (v2). Main points: we've tightened the de minimis to £10k and the basket to £50k, and asked for 'all reasonable endeavours' on the conditions. We're comfortable with the £2m Company cap for now but reserve on survival. Articles comments to follow from Deepa.

Oliver
